owner: Runtime technical defaults; commercial values PRODUCT.md; display values branding.json
rules: Unknown keys and duplicate JSON keys rejected.
Decimal values are strings; no float money.
Defaults do not establish measured capacity or grant target access.
Effective config is snapshotted per job/run/document; validation cannot weaken invariants.
Only add future-feature settings to runtime when that feature is implemented.
Only canonical keys are runtime inputs; old draft names are not supported aliases. A migration importer is built only for actual legacy data with explicit tested mappings.
